record.field: # Fetch all active allocations that are past the expected return date overdue_requests = env['asset.flow.asset.request'].search([ ('state', '=', 'done'), ('request_type', 'in', ['allocation', 'transfer']), ('expected_return_date', '<', datetime.date.today()) ]) for req in overdue_requests: req.message_post(body="Allocation is overdue. Please return or extend the expected return date.")

upcoming_bookings = env['asset.flow.resource.booking'].search([ ('state', '=', 'confirmed'), ('start_datetime', '<=', datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(hours=24)), ('start_datetime', '>', datetime.datetime.now()) ]) for booking in upcoming_bookings: booking.message_post(body="Reminder: You have an upcoming booking for this resource within the next 24 hours.")
